review: 708.4-1: polarities inverted; the face-up cast is where 708.4 does not apply (now does_not_fire) and the Essence Scatter check still applies the face-down characteristics (now other).
708.7-1: dropped variant cannot_pay; whether the morph cost can be paid is decided by cost-payment rules, not 708.7.
708.12-1: base expected implied the turned-up permanent is a plain Grizzly Bears; Song of the Dryads keeps applying (708.8), so it now states the permanent is a colorless Forest land.

scenarios.title: A face-down permanent has only the characteristics the effect lists, or 2/2 with nothing else when it lists none

setup.notes: Exalted Angel is a face-up 4/5 white Angel with flying and a morph ability. B holds Counterspell with two untapped Islands and casts it only in the variant that says so.

decisions: A casts Backslide targeting Exalted Angel, tapping both Islands.
B passes; Backslide resolves.

variants.label: backslide
variants.expected: Exalted Angel is turned face down by an effect that lists no characteristics. It is a 2/2 creature with no name, no mana cost, no color, no subtypes, no flying and no other abilities.

variants.label: cyber_conversion
variants.delta: A casts Cyber Conversion targeting Exalted Angel instead of Backslide.
variants.expected: Exalted Angel is face down with exactly the characteristics Cyber Conversion lists: a 2/2 artifact creature of subtype Cyberman. It has no name, no mana cost, no color, no flying and no other abilities.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response to Backslide, B casts Counterspell targeting it, tapping both of B's Islands.
variants.expected: Backslide is countered and goes to A's graveyard. Exalted Angel stays face up on the battlefield as a 4/5 white Angel with flying.

scenarios.forge_notes: Backslide requires a target creature with a morph ability, which face-up Exalted Angel has. The Cyber Conversion variant relies on Forge honouring FaceDownSetType, FaceDownPower and FaceDownToughness.

scenarios.title: A face-down permanent can't be turned face down again
decisions: A casts Cyber Conversion targeting Exalted Angel, tapping both Islands.
B passes; Cyber Conversion resolves.

variants.label: face_up_target
variants.expected: Cyber Conversion resolves. Exalted Angel is turned face down and is a 2/2 artifact creature of subtype Cyberman with no name, no flying and no other abilities.

variants.label: face_down_target
variants.delta: Exalted Angel is already face down on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Cyber Conversion resolves and nothing happens. The permanent stays a plain 2/2 face-down creature: it is not an artifact and has no Cyberman subtype.

scenarios.forge_notes: The face-down variant needs Forge to place Exalted Angel face down on the battlefield in the initial state (for example through a puzzle file).

scenarios.title: A permanent that enters face down doesn't trigger its enters-the-battlefield ability

setup.notes: Nightdrinker Moroii (4/2 flying, 'When Nightdrinker Moroii enters, you lose 3 life', disguise {B}{B}) may be cast face down for {3}. Face down it is a 2/2 with ward {2}.

decisions: A casts Nightdrinker Moroii face down for its disguise alternative cost of {3}, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; the face-down spell resolves.

variants.label: face_down
variants.expected: Nightdrinker Moroii enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Its enters-the-battlefield trigger does not fire. A's life total stays 20.

variants.label: face_up
variants.delta: A casts Nightdrinker Moroii face up for its mana cost {3}{B}, tapping all four Swamps.
variants.expected: Nightdrinker Moroii enters face up as a 4/2 flyer. Its enters-the-battlefield trigger fires and resolves. A's life total is 17.

scenarios.title: A spell cast face down has only face-down characteristics for targeting

setup.notes: Echo Tracer is a blue 2/2 Human Wizard with morph {2}{U}. B has priority first and casts it; A then receives priority with it on the stack.

decisions: B casts Echo Tracer face down for {3}, tapping three Islands.
B passes priority.
A, with priority, is checked for casting Red Elemental Blast (counter target blue spell) targeting the Echo Tracer spell, using Mountain.

variants.label: face_down_blast
variants.expected: Casting Red Elemental Blast is not legal against the face-down spell: the spell is colorless, so Red Elemental Blast has no legal target in its counter mode.

variants.label: face_up_blast
variants.delta: B casts Echo Tracer face up for {2}{U} instead of face down.
variants.expected: Casting Red Elemental Blast is legal: the blue Echo Tracer spell is a legal target for its counter mode.

variants.label: face_down_scatter
variants.delta: A checks Essence Scatter (counter target creature spell), tapping both of A's Islands, instead of Red Elemental Blast.
variants.expected: Casting Essence Scatter is legal: the face-down spell is a creature spell, so the Echo Tracer spell is a legal target.

scenarios.title: Only a face-down permanent's controller may turn it face up, and only while the rules allow it

setup.notes: Exalted Angel was cast face down and has morph {2}{W}{W}. A holds priority with an empty stack.

decisions: A is checked for turning the face-down Exalted Angel face up by paying its morph cost {2}{W}{W} with four Plains.

variants.label: own_permanent
variants.expected: Turning Exalted Angel face up is legal. A may do it any time A has priority.

variants.label: opponents_permanent
variants.delta: The face-down Exalted Angel is controlled by B.
variants.expected: Turning the face-down Exalted Angel face up is not legal for A.

variants.label: face_down_spell
variants.delta: The face-down Exalted Angel is a spell on the stack controlled by A instead of a permanent on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Turning the face-down Exalted Angel face up is not legal while it is a spell; spells can't be turned face up.

scenarios.forge_notes: Whether a morph is offered for turning face up is a playability verdict only; the stack variant needs the face-down spell placed on the stack in the initial state.

scenarios.title: Turning a permanent face up restores its normal characteristics, keeps earlier effects and triggers no enters-the-battlefield ability

setup.notes: The face-down Nightdrinker Moroii is a 2/2 with ward {2} and disguise {B}{B}. Face up it is a 4/2 flyer whose enters-the-battlefield ability makes its controller lose 3 life.

decisions: A casts Giant Growth targeting the face-down creature, tapping Forest.
B passes; Giant Growth resolves.
A turns the creature face up by paying its disguise cost {B}{B}, tapping both Swamps.

variants.label: turned_up
variants.expected: The permanent is Nightdrinker Moroii, a 7/5 flying creature (4/2 plus the +3/+3 from Giant Growth, still applying until end of turn). Its enters-the-battlefield ability does not trigger. A's life total stays 20.

variants.label: stays_down
variants.delta: A does not turn the creature face up.
variants.expected: The permanent is still face down: a nameless 5/5 creature (2/2 plus +3/+3) with ward {2} and no flying. A's life total stays 20.

scenarios.title: A face-down permanent that becomes a copy stays face down and takes the copied values when turned face up

setup.notes: Exalted Angel is a 4/5 flyer when face up whose controller gains life whenever it deals damage; Serra Angel is a 4/4 with flying and vigilance.

decisions: B casts Cytoshape targeting the face-down creature and choosing Serra Angel as the creature to copy, tapping Forest and both Islands.
A passes; Cytoshape resolves. B passes priority with an empty stack.
A casts Break Open targeting the face-down creature, tapping both Mountains.
B passes; Break Open resolves.

variants.label: turned_up
variants.expected: After Cytoshape resolves the permanent is still a face-down 2/2 with no name and no abilities. After Break Open resolves it is face up and has the copied values until end of turn: Serra Angel, a 4/4 with flying and vigilance, without Exalted Angel's lifegain ability.

variants.label: stays_down
variants.delta: A does not cast Break Open.
variants.expected: The permanent is still a face-down 2/2 with no name and no abilities after Cytoshape resolves and stays that way.

scenarios.forge_notes: Cytoshape's copy lasts until end of turn, so the turned-up values revert to Exalted Angel at the cleanup step.

scenarios.title: An 'as this is turned face up' ability applies while the permanent is being turned face up

setup.notes: Hooded Hydra is a 0/0 face up and has morph {3}{G}{G} and 'As Hooded Hydra is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters on it.' Face down it is a 2/2.

decisions: A turns Hooded Hydra face up by paying its morph cost {3}{G}{G}, tapping all five Forests.

variants.label: turned_up
variants.expected: Hooded Hydra is face up with five +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5. It is never a 0/0 permanent, so no state-based action puts it into the graveyard, and its dies trigger does not fire.

variants.label: stays_down
variants.delta: A does not turn Hooded Hydra face up.
variants.expected: Hooded Hydra stays face down as a nameless 2/2 with no counters.

scenarios.title: Revealing a face-down permanent reads its card, ignoring continuous effects on it

setup.notes: The face-down permanent is the card Grizzly Bears, manifested. Song of the Dryads makes it a colorless Forest land, so as a permanent it is not a creature. Hauntwoods Shrieker's ability: '{1}{G}: Reveal target face-down permanent. If it's a creature card, you may turn it face up.'

decisions: A activates Hauntwoods Shrieker's ability targeting the face-down permanent, paying {1}{G} with both Forests.
B passes; the ability resolves. A chooses to turn the permanent face up if allowed.

variants.label: creature_card
variants.expected: The permanent is revealed as Grizzly Bears, which is a creature card, because the reveal ignores Song of the Dryads. A turns it face up; it is Grizzly Bears, still enchanted by Song of the Dryads, and so a colorless Forest land that is not a creature.

variants.label: land_card
variants.delta: The face-down card is a Forest instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The permanent is revealed as a Forest, which is not a creature card. A can't turn it face up and it stays face down.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs Forge to reach a manifested face-down card as initial state. Forge's reveal check on the face-down permanent may read the current (overridden) types rather than the card's own.
